title: Developer Platform Railway Tells Users to Revoke Keys After Hack
excerpt: Railway urges all customers to revoke and rotate their private keys following a cyberattack that decrypted some customer secrets.
body_html:
Developer platform Railway has strongly advised all of its users to immediately revoke and rotate their private keys following a recent cyberattack.

According to the platform, hackers successfully breached the system and gained the ability to decrypt certain customer secrets.

In response to the security incident, the company issued a widespread warning urging every customer to take protective measures by changing their credentials.
